title: PM — Afterhours Rollup & Next-day Edits
content:
Quick after-hours rollup — rough, mostly for my brain.

Context: final PRD pass for feature toggle + canary for hosted-api rollout. Doing a short list of edits to ship tomorrow morning and blockers to clear during sync. Still rough; copy from meeting notes + comments from eng review.

Top priorities for 2026-03-11 (do before 10am PT)
- finalize acceptance criteria section in PRD (see RID-4321) — add explicit perf SLO example (p95 < 220ms for baseline model).
- update rollout plan to include region failover (EU -> US) and emergency fallback policy.
- merge wording changes from Maya on "data retention" paragraph.
- ping infra about canary capacity: confirm 4x burst GPUs for first 48h.
- create short customer-facing one-pager for CS (one-page summary + top-3 risks).

PRD edits (line items)
1) Acceptance criteria: add bulletized checks:
   - functional: endpoint returns structured json for tool-calls (examples + schema).
   - quality: automated eval set avg rouge >= 0.72 on smoke prompt set.
   - perf: p95 <= 220ms (non-stream), token throughput >= 1200 tok/s for dedicated pool.
2) Rollout steps: add step 1a: internal smoke to SRE + Solutions Eng channel, wait 2 hours.
3) Feature flagging: clarify gate names (feature.flags.hosted_api_v2, fallback.hosted_api_v1).
4) Observability: add explicit traces to instrument (trace keys: request_id, route, model_version, batch_size).
5) Backwards compatibility: add note on older SDKs — include a deprecation window + migration snippet.

Meeting follow-ups / who to ping
- Tom Park (infra): confirm GPU pool schedule — ask for capacity reservation ticket by 9am. (Jira: RID-4389)
- Maya Singh (content): confirm wording on customer one-pager, share by EOD.
- Dan Holloway (SRE lead): quick sync about canary circuit breaker thresholds.
- Legal: small blurb about telemetry retention — ask for <24h default for non-prod logs.

Launch checklist (short)
[ ] PRD final version uploaded to Confluence (tag: prd/launch-plan-v2)
[ ] Canary infra reservation confirmed (RID-4389)
[ ] GitHub PR for API docs merged (#789)
[ ] CS one-pager drafted and reviewed
[ ] Rollout playbook shared in #oncall and #launch-ops
[ ] Post-launch dashboard (daily) created: latency, errors, cost/unit, token-rate

Open questions / risks (need decisions)
- Q1: fallback model variant — should fallback compress output or keep fidelity? (tradeoff: cost vs UX). Need product decision by 9am.
- Q2: telemetry retention policy for private deployments — ops prefers shorter retention but enterprise customers want 90d. Draft compromise in PRD.
- Risk: canary capacity might be oversubscribed if another team runs a batch job same morning. Put a lock in schedule or coordinate with platform calendar.

Notes from engineering review (bullets copied raw)
- "KV cache edge-case when sequence length > 4k, fallback to chunked generation — need code sample." — assign to eng: @kyle
- "Quantization profile 8-bit shows 1.6x speedup in perf test SCC-3 but memory spikes on B4 machines." — investigate more; add to Optimize backlog.

Short timeline (draft)
- Mon AM: finalize PRD, reserve infra, merge docs
- Mon noon: internal smoke + SRE signoff window (2h)
- Mon 3pm: start canary ramp (5% -> 20% over 2h)
- Mon EOD: decide go/no-go for broader rollouts, capture regression metrics

Personal TODOs (timeboxed)
- 7:30–8:30am: edit PRD acceptance criteria (30m) + send to Maya (10m) + create Confluence snapshot (10m)
- 9:00–9:15am: ping infra + SRE (quick Slack)
- 9:30–10:30am: join sync with Solutions Eng (take notes)
- 11:00–11:30am: finalize one-pager for CS

Quick drafts to paste into Confluence / Slack (snippets)
- "Canary plan: will route 5% traffic to hosted_api_v2 for 2h; SRE will monitor p95, error-rate, token-cost; automatic rollback if p95 regression > 20% or error rate > 0.5% over 5m."
- "Customer-facing: This release reduces inference latency for short prompts and introduces structured function outputs. Default model remains the same; customers on dedicated pools can opt-in to new quantized variants."

Notes to self (random)
- remember to add an example curl for function calls (show content-type + streaming header)
- check SDK compatibility matrix before public docs
- follow up on GH issue re: schema mismatch in tool-calling tests (#issue-122)

End-of-night micro-retro
- what went well: tech review surfaced perf numbers early (helpful)
- what to improve: clearer gate names in PRD would have saved 20m in meeting
- immediate action: add naming convention note in PRD appendix (done tomorrow)

-- Elena

(If I wake up at 5am and feel productive: write the short customer one-pager first so CS can start edits.)
